entities.name: Herbert Brück
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Herbert Israel Brück was an Austrian ice hockey player. He competed in the men's tournament at the 1928 Winter Olympics. During World War II, he was interned at the Sachsenhausen concentration camp and survived.
